_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for FANG (Diamondback Energy, Inc., CIK 1539838), generated by retro/generators/fang/gen_fang.py from the filings; every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after its 'published' date (EDGAR's acceptance time in ET: accepted at or after 16:00, the next trading day). It holds what decides whether a date can be built under method r2, and nothing else: each offering document's and 10-K's annual history, the FY2012 first-day tax charge, the listing record, the no-dividend statement and the price basis. No share of Diamondback traded before 2012-10-12; the predecessors were limited liability companies with no shares, and no filing to 2013-12-31 prints a GAAP earnings per share for any full year (2012's only per-share figure is pro forma), so no date of 2008-2013 has a full year of the company's own EPS to anchor a P/E and none is built (retro/README.md, "FANG 2008-2009"). No print, guide, signal or theme event is transcribed, and the builder refuses any date that passes the gate until they are.
price_basis: Yahoo's FANG series is Diamondback Energy, Inc.'s common stock (NASDAQ: FANG) from its first point, 2012-10-12 (firstTradeDate), the first trading day the FY2012 10-K states; Yahoo's series records no split. No share of the issuer or its predecessors traded before it (the predecessors were limited liability companies controlled by Wexford Capital LP).

history_vintages.eps_basis: the statements of operations print net income (loss) and no GAAP earnings per share for any year; the only per-share figure is 2012's unaudited pro forma earnings per common share (a pro forma income tax provision as if the Company and the Predecessors had been subject to income taxes since 2011-12-31, on shares as if those issued upon the Merger had been outstanding for the entire year)
history_vintages.pro_forma_quote: The Company’s pro forma basic earnings per share amounts have been computed based on the weighted-average number of shares of common stock outstanding for the period, as if the common shares issued upon the Merger were outstanding for the entire year.
history_vintages.one_offs_note: 2012: net loss $36.521M after the $54.142M first-day deferred tax charge of the Merger (the deferred income tax provision on the statement of operations), against $18.382M of income before income taxes: the charge exceeds the year's income before it (the AAPL FY2002 test), and no filing publishes a per-share figure excluding only it (the pro forma figure also replaces it with a full year's hypothetical tax and an as-if share count)
history_vintages.first_day_quote: On the date of the merger, a corresponding “first day” tax expense to net income from continuing operations was recorded to establish a net deferred tax liability for differences between the tax and book basis of Diamondback’s assets and liabilities. This charge was $54,142,000.
history_vintages.llc_quote: The operations of Windsor Permian and Windsor UT, as limited liability companies, were not subject to federal income taxes.

listings.quote: This is the initial public offering of our common stock. Prior to this offering, there has been no public market for our common stock.
Common Stock, par value $0.01 per share | The NASDAQ Stock Market LLC
We have been approved to list our common stock on The NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol “FANG.”

As of June 30, 2012, the last business day of the registrant’s most recently completed second fiscal quarter, there was no public market for the registrant’s common stock. The registrant’s common stock began trading on the NASDAQ Global Select Market on October 12, 2012.
listings.quote_note7: On October 11, 2012, the Company priced 12,500,000 shares of common stock in the IPO at $17.50 per share, and on October 12, 2012, shares of the Company’s common stock began trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “FANG”.

no_dividend.quote: We have not paid any cash dividends since our inception.

release_notes.quote: The Company’s pro forma net loss after the non-cash income tax charge to earnings for Q4 2012 and full year 2012 was a ($51.4) million loss and a ($29.8) million loss, respectively.
